window.title: Answer window
window.help: When students may answer. Leave the start empty to open right after the due date.

groupWindows.allAssigned: Every tutorial group has its own window.
groupWindows.noGroups: This course has no tutorial groups.

questions.title: Questions
questions.help: Main questions are generated once after the due date; follow-ups are generated live while the student answers.

answerLength.title: Answer length
answerLength.help: Steers how much the model expects in an answer and how much time it allows.

hint.title: Hints for the question generator (optional)
hint.help: Learning goals, files to avoid, wording preferences. Shown to nobody else.

timer.title: Timer
timer.help: The model chooses a time limit per question inside this range, depending on the question's complexity. Better too much time than too little.

rating.title: Rating
rating.threshold: Ask a follow-up when the rating is at most
rating.scaleLocked: The scale cannot change after students have started the check.

review.title: Review the generated questions before students see them
review.help: Questions wait for your approval until a student's window opens; questions that are still unapproved then are released automatically. Follow-ups are never reviewed.

settings.banner: Generation starts automatically after the due date (or the individual due date) and runs in the background, so a whole cohort is ready before the first window opens. If the due date has already passed, it starts 10 minutes after you switch the check on: set the window, the hint and the review option first. For an exercise whose due date and windows lie more than 30 days back, use "Generate missing questions" on the dashboard. Students who opted out of AI features, and students without a submission, are listed as skipped on the dashboard.
settings.invalid: The comprehension check has invalid settings: check the answer windows and the time limits.
settings.endBeforeStart: The window end must be after its start.
settings.minAboveMax: The shortest limit must not exceed the longest limit.
